title: Step
description: One agent step from the harness. thinking_tokens and cached_tokens are optional and are not required. Other Step properties are allowed so a real step record can be dropped in. This copy sits beside results schema 2.1.0. It is not schema 3.0.0.

thinking_tokens.description: Optional count of thinking tokens on this step. Omit it when the provider does not report them.

cached_tokens.description: Optional count of cached tokens on this step. Omit it when the provider does not report them.
